indication: long term to help open the airways in adults with breathing difficulties due to COPD
single_dose: 60 doses, with each dose containing 400 mcg of aclidinium bromide and 12 mcg of formoterol fumarate dihydrate
mechanism_of_action: helps to control COPD by opening the airways
side_effects: headache, dizziness, blurred vision, eye pain or discomfort, temporary blurring of vision, visual halos or colored images in association with red eyes, tightness of the chest, coughing, wheezing or breathlessness immediately after inhalation (signs of bronchospasm), difficulties in breathing or swallowing, swelling of tongue, lips and face, hives or itching, skin rash (signs of hypersensitivity reaction)
unsuitable_population: heart problems, such as rapid or irregular heart beat or an abnormal electrical signal called 'prolongation of the QT interval' || have a tumour in one of your adrenal glands (phaeochromocytoma) || are breastfeeding
